correctness.rationale: For every integer repetition \(r\ge1\) the positive simple Perron mode is invariant under nine-site rotation, so its eigenvalue is that of one period; shifting/scaling reduces the general case to \(t=d/g\). Exact bivariate continuants give \(P_A(z,t)-P_B(z,t)=t^4(2t+z)(t^2-4t-2z+1)\). The top eigenvalues lie strictly in \((4/9,1)\), are continuous, and strictly decrease in \(t\). The exact \(474/941\) Rayleigh quotient at \(t=4\) implies \(\Lambda_B>1/2\) for \(t\le4\); the function \(q(t)=(t^2-4t+1)/2\) increases for \(t\ge4\), meeting decreasing \(\Lambda_B\) once in \((4,5)\). Weyl second-eigen bounds and the exact \(62/101\) Rayleigh witness at \(t=1\) establish the signs at \(t=1\) and \(t=5\); continuity and uniqueness yield the global classification. The standalone script verify_model.py was run from its actual package source path: exact determinant, 24 direct Bareiss checks and rational witness tests passed, auxiliary numerical tests passed. Numerical root estimates and finite repeated-instance checks are explicitly not the infinite-parameter proof. No singular denominator or excluded zero contrast is used.

originality.rationale: The assessed specific mathematical statement is the unique crossing between the named nonextremal two-patch cyclic landscapes with fixed habitat area and interface count, for every positive normalized dispersal and for arbitrarily many repetitions. Flather--Bevers directly motivates the geometric comparison but uses a nonlinear simulated population model; Nadin proves optimality of a completely Schwarz-rearranged continuum profile rather than a pairwise comparison of nonextremal discrete landscapes; Liang describes an optimal bell-shaped discrete arrangement rather than the exact inter-ranking or single-crossing polynomial. Closest published findings concern other ecological models, spectral cocycles or unrelated cycle combinatorics, not an implication of this theorem. Uninspected stronger coverage in Liang and the full Berestycki--Hamel--Roques article remains a disclosed specific risk; a negative search alone is not the basis for PASS.

value.rationale: The four favorable sites, two suitable components, and four environmental interfaces per nine-cell period are intentionally held equal, because habitat amount, patch count and edge length are common mechanistic fragmentation summaries in Flather--Bevers (2002). The competing natural partitions \((1,3)\) and \((2,2)\) of favorable run lengths have an exact single growth-ranking reversal; this identifies a precise mathematical boundary where those summaries fail to rank landscapes independently of dispersal. The mechanism holds at every integer period repetition and positive contrast, not merely one numerical matrix. The profiles address a concrete literature-motivated ecological geometric comparison and support an all-parameter sign theorem; the result is not a routine substitution. No empirical or downstream inference is asserted.
